author: smeriano
body:
This PR extends the phase-2 tau validation workflow with new decay-mode plots for both HLT and RECO taus.

The new histograms are stored in a dedicated `DecayModes` DQM folder. A helper script is also added to produce comparison and summary plots for the different decay modes. 

Tagging @elenavernazza
title: Adding Decay Modes for the Tau Phase 2 Validation tool
